measurement_type: Derived summary of existing accepted RTX 5090 measurements; no new trials.

memory_semantics.allocated: Torch allocator peak; excludes total device occupancy and complete driver/context overhead.
memory_semantics.reserved: Torch allocator reserved peak, including its cache; not interchangeable with allocated.
memory_semantics.aggregation: Maximum recorded per-call peak in the selected method/scale panel, not mean memory.

tsp_metadata_note: Allocator peaks and resolved selector counts supplement the existing four CUDA p-bit natural calls. Hashes bind their archived source summaries and existing call manifests; complete trajectories are not redistributed.

tsp-5090.resource_boundary: CPU selector states are coupled and updated sequentially; GPU batches local descent tours. Allocator peak is measured over the whole call, not at the first certificate.
